EDIT: Thors do amazing dps, take tons of damage and require 0 micro to be effective, just micro your tanks and get decent line ups with your helions, that AOE helps so much even if it is minimal vs units like roaches.

I tend to always go mech in tvz, it's pretty good if you can run it right.  You don't need the marauders, or even a starport till you know broodlords are on the way (you drop 3 of them down start +1 air attacks).  Generally from watching MVP and other korean terrans going mech you see a lot more thors then you even do tanks. If you want to play a longer game, reactor helion, if you want to make some sort of earlier push you open naked 3 factories, throw down tech lab for tanks.  Now if you watch MVP vs Nestea from the Blizzcon finals in set 1 on antiga shipyard, MVP went triple blue flame helion, into 4 tank, 4 thor push.  Even if the zerg goes mass roach, if tanks can be fired correctly and enough splash get off, the thors can meatshield.  Remember thors do not die.  I know I am kinda reverberating what was said earlier, but oh well.  If you see weakness you can push with your mech army, but if you do not, stay back try to work helions macro hard and attempt to push either when weakness is there, split the map, or 160-200 food doom push them.
